faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Got questions about the membership, payments, or access? We've got you covered.
faq.q1: How do I pay for the membership?
faq.a1: Payment is made securely via Moroccan bank transfer (RIB). When you create an account, you receive our verified banking coordinates (account holder name, RIB number, Attijariwafa Bank) along with a unique reference code. Complete the transfer through your banking application or bank branch, upload the receipt screenshot on your activation page, and submit.
faq.q2: How long does access approval take?
faq.a2: Our administration team verifies incoming payments throughout the day. Approval typically takes between a few minutes to a few hours (maximum 24 hours). The moment your transfer is approved, your account status updates automatically and all video lessons unlock immediately.
faq.q3: Can I watch the lessons on my mobile phone?
faq.a3: Yes, 100%. The Levelling Up platform is built mobile-first. It runs flawlessly on smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers. You can log in from Safari, Chrome, or any modern mobile browser with full-screen playback and high-definition streaming.
faq.q4: Is this a recurring subscription or a one-time payment?
faq.a4: It is a 100% one-time payment. There are no recurring monthly charges, automatic card renewals, or hidden fees. Once you unlock access, you receive permanent lifetime access to all lessons in the library, including new releases added in the future.
faq.q5: How do I contact support if I have questions?
faq.a5: Our team is available directly via WhatsApp and email. You can tap the "Contact" button in the navigation or footer at any time to open a direct support conversation with our team.
